title: Assessment of Bimodal Contribution in Adult Cochlear Implant Users
brief_summary: To evaluate the combination of electric hearing through Cochlear Implant and acoustic hearing through hearing aid in bimodal users with moderate-to-severe hearing loss in the non-implanted ear. The research will also provide pilot study data on unilateral Cochlear Implant recipients with residual useful acoustic hearing in the implanted ear whose acoustic hearing has been preserved.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Bilateral-bimodal users
* With moderate-to-severe hearing loss at 250 Hz, 500 Hz and 1000 Hz in the non-implanted ear
* Who use hearing aids for at least 75% of their waking hours

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
